metadata.title: आदिवासी नौकरी और व्यवसाय से ग़ायब क्यों | Why tribals are deprived of better job opportunities
metadata.description: Employment of Adivasis had always been a topic of debate. We have tried to understand this with the help of the Xaxa Committee Report. Data in this topic presents a mixed scenario, on one hand majority among the adivasis are employed,  while on the other hand economically they are still on the lower rung of the society. Even after he provision of reservations in public jobs and public education institutions, the upward social mobility among the tribals is almost negligible, we have tried to explain these in this video.
